analyst_summary: Synthetic fixed facts indicate repeat-demand stockouts and a buyer conversion opportunity, but do not establish live-market demand or a winning policy. Propose bounded measurement and routing tests; preserve operating parameters because no supported policy change is established.
critic_summary: Synthetic fixtures—not live market observations—show repeat paid sales and stockouts, supporting a bounded stock-coverage response if fresh supply guards and the full refund reserve pass. Do not promote an economic trial: the price frontier has no overlap and maturity is 9 of 20. Preserve current parameters; the 6% goods conversion does not establish a price-gap cause.
